An empty path selects the entire document. Literal segments select dictionary keys; decimal segments index lists; `*` expands all dictionary values in insertion order or all list items in index order; and `$name` substitutes a segment from `variables`, whose value must be a string. Return a list of deep-copied selected values in deterministic expansion order. If multiple selected positions refer to the same mutable object, preserve that alias inside the returned list, while sharing no mutable objects with the input. Reject non-string paths and non-mapping variables.

import unittest
from collections import OrderedDict

from solution import select_values


class SelectValuesTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_empty_path_selects_deep_copy_of_entire_document(self):
        document = {"a": [1, {"b": 2}]}
        selected = select_values(document, "")
        self.assertEqual(selected, [document])
        self.assertIsNot(selected[0], document)
        self.assertIsNot(selected[0]["a"], document["a"])
        selected[0]["a"][1]["b"] = 99
        self.assertEqual(document["a"][1]["b"], 2)

    def test_literals_list_indexes_and_wildcards(self):
        document = OrderedDict([
            ("groups", [
                {"name": "first", "values": [10, 11]},
                {"name": "second", "values": [20, 21]},
            ]),
            ("tail", 99),
        ])
        self.assertEqual(select_values(document, "groups/1/name"), ["second"])
        self.assertEqual(select_values(document, "groups/*/values/0"), [10, 20])
        self.assertEqual(select_values(document, "*"), [document["groups"], 99])

    def test_nested_wildcards_have_deterministic_expansion_order(self):
        document = {
            "left": {"a": 1, "b": 2},
            "right": {"c": 3, "d": 4},
        }
        self.assertEqual(select_values(document, "*/*"), [1, 2, 3, 4])

    def test_variable_substitution_and_variables_not_mutated(self):
        document = {"users": [{"name": "a"}, {"name": "b"}]}
        variables = {"index": "1", "field": "name"}
        original = dict(variables)
        self.assertEqual(
            select_values(document, "users/$index/$field", variables), ["b"]
        )
        self.assertEqual(variables, original)

    def test_alias_is_preserved_in_output_but_detached_from_input(self):
        shared = {"items": []}
        document = {"a": shared, "b": shared}
        selected = select_values(document, "*")
        self.assertIs(selected[0], selected[1])
        self.assertIsNot(selected[0], shared)
        selected[0]["items"].append(1)
        self.assertEqual(selected[1]["items"], [1])
        self.assertEqual(shared, {"items": []})

    def test_missing_keys_variables_and_bad_indexes(self):
        with self.assertRaises(KeyError):
            select_values({"a": 1}, "missing")
        with self.assertRaises(KeyError):
            select_values({"a": 1}, "$missing", {})
        with self.assertRaises(IndexError):
            select_values([1], "1")
        with self.assertRaises(IndexError):
            select_values([1], "-1")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            select_values({"a": 1}, "") if False else select_values({"a": 1}, "a/")

    def test_incompatible_containers_and_malformed_segments(self):
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            select_values({"a": 1}, "a/b")
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            select_values([1, 2], "not-an-index")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            select_values({"a": 1}, "/a")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            select_values({"a": 1}, "a//b")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            select_values({"a": 1}, "$", {})

    def test_argument_type_validation(self):
        for path in [None, 1, b"a"]:
            with self.subTest(path=path):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    select_values({}, path)
        for variables in [[], "x", 1]:
            with self.subTest(variables=variables):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    select_values({}, "", variables)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
